purpose: Master index of every copy-bearing 'thing' in the AOP app. copy_review.html reads this file, then loads each kind's root file(s) and renders the actual text in one printable page. Each entry names the root file(s) (repo-relative — the filesystem location), where the copy surfaces in the app, its review status, and whether the copy lives in a data file ('data') or is still embedded in markup/JS ('in_code'). For in_code kinds, the literal copy is mirrored here under `copy` so the review page can show it without parsing index.html.

status_legend.live: Wording is in use and considered settled enough to print.
status_legend.proposed: Placeholder / planning copy; must be confirmed with AOP or the event lead before it reads as official.
status_legend.owed: Copy is missing — a gap flagged for someone to write.

extraction_legend.data: Copy lives in its own data file under website/data/ — edit there.
extraction_legend.in_code: Copy is still embedded in index.html / manifest.json at the noted location; cataloged here, extraction deferred.
